CloudSave.title: CloudSave
CloudSave.description: Stores a player's cross-device cloud save state, meta progression, achievements, and ad-removal purchase status.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this save.

saveDataJson.description: Serialized game save state including equipment, inventory, floor, meta upgrades, and achievements.

level.description: Current hero level in the saved run.

floor.description: Current dungeon floor in the saved run.

metaShards.description: Accumulated relic shards for meta progression.

adsRemoved.description: Whether the user has unlocked the No-Ads premium status.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Represents a global cross-platform high score entry in the Last Relic leaderboard.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID who achieved this score.

playerClass.description: Hero class used for the run (warrior, rogue, mage, tank, necromancer).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/cloud_saves/{userId}.description: Per-user cloud save state keyed by the user's UID.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Global leaderboard entries keyed by userId or run entryId.
